scope: Frozen2297 train03 origins; original per-workload partitions, all future horizons already evaluated. Supplemental descriptive statistics only; no fit, model loading, new inference or external validation.

definitions.macro: Five workload metrics computed separately, then arithmetic mean. RMSE macro is mean of five RMSEs; Pearson macro is a descriptive mean, not pooled correlation.
definitions.degenerate: undefined R2 or correlation is null; never replaced with zero.
definitions.pooled: All five workloads mixed; level differences can inflate pooled R2/r and mask weak within-workload forecasts.
